Compared the bedroom window, kitchen window and living-room windows: the living room keeps work separate from sleep and avoids the kitchen work area; the west-wall position leaves the middle open. Modest neutral starting choice; budget unconfirmed. Catalog price 104000 AMD is mock pricing, not a shop quote. No chair requested or included.
